title: MissionCharterV1
description: Formal intake contract for a theFactory mission. Produced by the PM Agent during Phase 1 (PM_INTAKE) of the Mission Flow V2 lifecycle.

schema.description: Schema identifier and version. Must be exactly 'mission_charter.v1'.

charter_id.description: Unique identifier for this charter instance (UUID recommended).

mission_type.description: The class of work this mission represents.

depth_mode.description: How thoroughly this mission should be executed.

output_mode.description: What the mission is permitted to produce or apply.

data_classification.description: Sensitivity classification of the target repo / source code. Governs which LLM providers may be used.

source_type.description: How the target source material is being provided.

target_outcome.description: Short human-readable statement of what success looks like.

risk_level.description: Operator-assessed risk level for this mission.

required_agents.description: Agent IDs that must be activated for this mission.

provider_routing_policy.description: LLM provider routing constraint derived from data_classification.

human_approval_required.description: Whether any human approval gate must be passed before code changes are applied.

approval_gates_required.description: Which approval gates are required for this mission's depth_mode.

expected_artifacts.description: Artifact types this mission is expected to produce.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this charter was created.

approved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this charter was approved by an operator. Null until approved.

approved_by.description: Operator identifier who approved this charter. Null until approved.

notes.description: Optional operator notes captured during charter intake.
